data.summary: RCG_DiscordInboundDaemon.cs 寫好 + Unity 編譯 clean (0 errors, 0 warnings). 模仿 UCL_BartenderDaemon [InitializeOnLoad] + EditorApplication.update 5s tick 模式. 防 crash loop: 連 3 fail → 60s backoff. Token 缺 / config disabled 安靜不擾民. domain reload + Editor 退出時 graceful kill 子程序避免 zombie. stdout/stderr async pipe → Debug.Log 直接看到 bot 訊息. 放專案內 (Scripts/Editor/), 沒動 UCL_Core 三層 bump.
